mapper.update: UPDATE qa_answer SET cancelled_stage = status, status = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED', cancel_idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}, cancel_reason = #{reason}, cancel_requested_at = #{requestedAt}, cancel_error_code = NULL WHERE public_id = #{answerId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRIEVING', 'QUERYING', 'GENERATING')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM qa_answer WHERE public_id = #{answerId} AND status IN ('CANCEL_REQUESTED', 'CANCELLED', 'CANCEL_FAILED')

SELECT answer_id FROM qa_answer_cancel_task WHERE (task_status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (task_status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC, answer_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.answer_id, a.owner_id, a.message_id, a.cancelled_stage, t.attempt_count FROM qa_answer_cancel_task t JOIN qa_answer a ON a.public_id = t.answer_id WHERE t.answer_id = #{answerId} AND t.task_status = 'PROCESSING' AND t.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND a.status = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED'
